content:
Apple is facing ongoing supply chain constraints, with MacBook Air stock rapidly depleting. Below are the latest details on MacBook Air availability from Apple and third-party retail partners.

MacBook Air Supply Constraints

If you try to buy a MacBook Air from Apple's online store today, nearly all configurations show estimated delivery times of 2 to 3 weeks. In-store availability is equally tight, with most stores expecting stock for in-store pickup no earlier than the first week of September. This situation applies to both the 13-inch and 15-inch MacBook Air models.

Custom-configured MacBook Air models with higher RAM and storage are even more severely affected. For example, the 13-inch MacBook Air with 32GB of RAM cannot ship within a month, while in-store pickup is unavailable until the last week of September.

Bloomberg earlier reported the MacBook Air stock shortages, attributing the issue to ongoing industry-wide memory supply constraints. Mark Gurman noted that Apple, due to supply limitations, has been actively encouraging customers to purchase the MacBook Pro instead. According to Apple retail staff, MacBook Air shipments are "the tightest they can remember."

At Apple's most recent earnings call, CFO Kevan Parekh warned that the supply constraints affecting iPhone, iPad, and Mac would worsen further during the current quarter.

Where to Buy a MacBook Air Right Now

The Apple Store is certainly not the only place to buy a MacBook Air. In fact, supply appears to be better at some Apple retail partners.

On Amazon, several MacBook Air models are available for immediate shipping, with some configurations priced lower than Apple's retail price.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB/512GB: from $1,243 (original price $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB/1TB: from $1,499 (original price $1,599)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 24GB/1TB: from $1,649 (original price $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB/512GB: from $1,399 (original price $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB/1TB: from $1,689 (original price $1,799)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 24GB/1TB: from $1,904 (original price $1,999)

There's no way to know exactly how much MacBook Air inventory Amazon currently holds. They are likely to face the same supply issues as Apple soon, but for now, supply remains stable.

Some M5 MacBook Air configurations are also available for immediate shipping through the Apple Certified Refurbished store.

  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB/512GB: $1,099 (original new price $1,299)
  • 13-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB/1TB: $1,359 (original new price $1,599)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB/512GB: $1,269 (original new price $1,499)
  • 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 24GB/1TB: $1,699 (original new price $1,999)
  • …and additional configurations…

Products purchased from the Apple Certified Refurbished store come with a one-year warranty, a 14-day return policy, and are eligible for AppleCare coverage.

Summary

If you're planning to buy a MacBook Air, I recommend acting quickly. I expect Apple's supply shortages will worsen before they improve. The next MacBook Air is not expected to launch until next year at the earliest, and it will likely only feature minor specification upgrades.

Are you considering buying a new Mac? Has the ongoing supply shortage affected your plans? Feel free to share with us in the comments section.
